backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user profiles, Stripe payment integration, blob storage, and access control with role-based permissions for users and admins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented admin authentication features including AdminLogin page, session management, protected routes, and admin panel with logout functionality.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including pages, hooks, layouts, and utilities with details on animations, authentication, and UI features.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes including colors for background, foreground, primary, secondary, sidebar, and chart elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application router configuration using TanStack Router with routes for landing page, dashboard sections, admin panel (protected by AdminProtectedRoute), payment flows, and policy pages.

frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup, collecting username, full name, email, mobile, and Discord user ID with form validation.

frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook for saving user profile data, updating the cache on success (backend call currently stubbed).

frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
